note: Portable skill content vendored into .agents/skills/ and committed so every contributor and every agent gets the same set, taken from one upstream: https://github.com/shruggietech/skills, at the release named in each entry's source field. A skill is admitted only if a named constitution principle binds this repository to it or a repository gate executes it; see skills/README.md. Codex reads this path natively. Claude Code and Cursor read their own directories, which an external skills CLI may populate with machine-local symlinks; those are gitignored, and a checkout may carry none at all. computedHash is SHA-256 over every file in the skill directory, path-sorted, not SKILL.md alone. Content is normalized to LF before hashing, matching .gitattributes, so the hash is reproducible from a fresh clone on any platform. speckit-* skills are omitted: the spec-kit CLI owns them and records them in .specify/integrations/*.manifest.json.
